text:
Confusion is the god

madness is the god

the permanent peace of life

is the permanent peace of death…


Agony can kill

or it can sustain life

but peace is always horrible

peace is the worst thing

walking

talking

smiling

seeming to be

Do not forget the sidewalks,

the whores,

betrayal,

the worm in the apple,

the bars,

the prisons

the suicides of lovers.


Here in the United States

we have murdered a president and his brother,

another president had to leave office.


People who believe in politics

are like people who believe in God:

stroking air with bent

straws.


There is no God

there is no politics

there is no peace

there is no love

there is no control

there are no plans.


Stay away from God

remain anguished

slip away.

translation.title: Embrace the Darkness
translation.editorial_note: Translated from the supplied Spanish version of Charles Bukowski. The source’s colloquial voseo imperatives are rendered as direct English imperatives, and the lineation is preserved.
